name: io.github.writerslogic/ai-agents-mcp
title: WritersLogic AI Agents (x402)
description: Pay-per-call AI agents over x402. Settled in USDC on Base with a per-call spending cap.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated, low-balance wallet holding USDC on Base. Signs gasless EIP-3009 payment authorizations. Without it, paid tools return payment instructions instead of paying.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USDC_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC the client will authorize for a single tool call. Calls priced above it are refused.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hub API key sent as X-API-KEY. Bypasses payment.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hub base URL (https only; http allowed for localhost).

environmentVariables.name: AGENTS_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: "all" or a comma-separated list of package ids whose checks are listed as individual tools instead of one tool per package.
